rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just south of a hillock that shows
evidence of long-waged battles.  The yellow-green reeds of grain grow tall
here, and seem to deepen into a richer, brighter hue as you head south, up
the face of the sloping hills and into the wilderness beyond.
   Hills of greenery continue all around you, save north, where a defensable
hillock looks out over the northern desert, and west, where outcroppings of
basalt appear to have been blasted out of the ground at odd angles.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, lost in the reeds and waving 
mass of wild grains that sway with the wind.  The ground is steep here,
and ascends into the hills to the south.
   The hills continue all around you, growing less steep as you head
north.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just west of a road that splits
these foothills into separate tracts of land.  Though the grass and reeds
around you are chest-high, you can make out the desert to the south and
catch the faintest whiff of carrion on the breeze.
   The hills continue all around you, save east, where a road offers some
sense of direction.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
The road widens here into a large circular lot as the northern caravan
trail through the forest meets this lane that comes straight out of the 
hills to the south.
   A few empty, broken crates litter the ground here, perhaps evidence of
an accident, or a past enchange of goods between those who dwell in the
mountains and those who live on the coast and in the desert.
   Hills and fields span to the eastern and western horizons, while the
road continues north and south.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:

these foothills into separate tracts of land.  Though the grass and reeds
around you are chest-high, you can make out the desert to the south and
catch the faintest sound of a screeching hawk on the breeze.
   Grasses sway all around you, save west, where a road offers some sense
of direction.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a hill of high grass, just west of a dense thicket
of impenetrable undergrowth.  It appears that this is the eastern border
of the grassy foothills, where it stops amid a cluster of tall, leafy
trees and mountain-rainforest-type shrubs.
   To the north you can see the hills merge with rich savanna fields, 
while to the south, you can barely make out a path through the densely
covered hills as they rise.  The hills continue at this elevation to the
west.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:
You are wandering in some tall grass, just east of the site of a tectonic
shift, where plates far below you have pushed masses of granite and basalt
to the surface to form an effective barrier against travel.
   The reeds below your feet crunch with dryness and you realize that even
a single bolt of lightning could set the fields alight.
   The hills continue all around you, growing steeper as you head south.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are travelling along an oft-travelled road that splits the hills
as it climbs higher into the mountains to the south.  Shrubs and tall
grasses spring from the moist ground, perhaps tapping some unseen water
source deep in the ground and away from the harsh desert heat to the
north.
   The road continues to the north and south, while the hills extend far
to the east and west.

rooms.name: Sloping Hills
rooms.desc:

these foothills into separate tracts of land.  The grass is dry here and
could definitely use some rain to prevent field fires.
   Grasses sway all around you, save west, where a road offers some sense
of direction.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a gravel road that winds though the rolling hills
all around you.  Greenery and a few shady trees mar the otherwise seemless
terrain to the east and west, while the road ascends into the higher slopes
to the south.
   Far to the south, you can make out a desert that flanks the road.

rooms.desc:

   To the north you can see the path wind through down the shrub-covered

   The hills continue at this elevation to the west, though you have to
hack your way through some brush to get through it.

rooms.name: Cliff Face
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop a hill, just below a near-vertical cliff face.
The view from here is extraordinary, as you look out over the rolling
hills to the south and east.
   To the west outcroppings of tectonic plate shifts have thrust up from
the surface and prevented traveling in that direction, while to the south,
the cliff face provides an even more impassible climb, as the faint rushing
of gusting winds prevent you from even flying to the top.

rooms.name: Cliff Face
rooms.desc:
You are standing atop a hill, just below a near-vertical cliff face.
The view from here is extraordinary, as you look out over the rolling
hills to the south and east.
   To the east and west, the tall hills continue to roll across the
region, while to the south, the cliff face provides an impassible climb,
as the sounds of powerful winds resonate off the rock above you.

rooms.name: A Carved Cliff
rooms.desc:
You stand below a vertical cliff, looking out over the northern
horizon, across fields and rolling hills of tall grass.  
   Here, someone has taken the time to chisel into the rock the head
of a serpent - a companion to the one across the road to the east.
It appears that gems or glass were once in place in the carving's
eyes, but have long since vanished.
   The hills continue to the west and north, while a road appears
to scale the mountains to the east.  Only the cliff face appears to
the south and there seems no way to scale it.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a gravel road that winds though the rolling hills
all around you.  Trees and shrubs dot the grassy terrain while patches
of moss and lichens adorn their trunks and stems.
   The hills continue to the east and west, while the road ascends to
the south and flows through the rolling terrain to the south.

of impenetrable undergrowth.  It appears that this is the eastern border
of the grassy foothills, where it stops amid a cluster of tall, leafy
trees and mountain-rainforest-type shrubs.
   To the north you can see the path stop abruptly at a tall shelf of 
rock, while to the south, you can barely make out the trail that winds
through the sloping hills.
   The hills continue at this elevation to the west, though you have to
hack your way through some brush to get through it.

rooms.name: A Road Through The Hills
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rough gravel road where the sloping hills begin
their ascent into the snow-capped peaks to the south.  Rocks and tall,
leafy trees blanket the terrain and surround the road while offering a
bit of shelter to the noisy groundling birds and squirrels that chitter
at your approach.
   The hills continue to the east and west, while the road ascends to
the south and flows through the rolling terrain to the south.

rooms.name: A Mountain Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a steep road, surrounded by tall pines.  The view
from here is lovely and to the north you can look out and see the desert
across the northern horizon.
   Mossy rocks lie to either side of the road, their green faces showing
which way is north, while their lichens point out the western direction
of the mountain.
   The road descends into the lower elevations to the north and climbs
high into the clouds to the south.  Rocks and trees lie too dense to 
travel anywhere else.

rooms.name: A Mountain Road
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a steep road, surrounded by tall pines that block
the rushing winds you hear whipping their green tops.  The view from here
is extraordinary and to the north you can look out and see the desert and
the ocean beyond it.
   Mossy rocks rest to either side of the road, the grooves at their base
showing signs that they had been moved from the ascending trail to allow
easier passage up and down the mountain.
   The road descends into the lower elevations to the north and climbs
high into the clouds to the south.  Rocks and trees lie too dense to 
travel anywhere else.

rooms.name: A Mountainous Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rock-strewn road that ascends the icy mountain
below you.  The air is growing thin and your breath is starting to become
labored.
   The road ascends to the south and descends to the north.

rooms.name: A Mountainous Trail
rooms.desc:
You are standing on a rock-strewn road that ascends the icy mountain
below you.  The air is thin here and you find yourself taking two heavy
breaths just to keep your vision from becoming blurred and your head 
from swimming.
   The air smells of rich pine, and its heady scent is only reinforced
by the jumbles of pine cones that litter both the steep road and the 
forest flanking it.
   The road ascends the mountain to the south and slopes downward to the
north.

rooms.name: A Mountain Pass
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a gusty, snowy mountain pass.  A narrow road cuts
through a break in the peak before you to the south, slicing through a
large jumble of fallen stones that flank the open road.  The way south
seems to level off a bit into a plateau-like smoothness into the peaks
before turning steeply upward after a few hundred yards while the road
bends sharply down the face of the mountain to the north.
